svg.title: Copy and Paste
svg.desc: AI assistant to You: Proposes a recovery block for review. You to Kit and repository: Runs the approved block locally. Kit and repository to You: Provides a log header for the output. Command: agentic-kit transfer log-header. You to AI assistant: Pastes the relevant output into the chat.
